name: Lingua — Conlang Builder
subtitle: Your script, your language
description:
Lingua is where you make a language and then actually use it.

YOUR SCRIPT
Draw each letter with your finger. Lingua compiles your letters into a real font on your phone, and gives you a keyboard inside the app with your letters on the keys. Alphabet, abjad, syllabary, abugida or logography, written in any direction. Digits are letters too, in whatever base you choose.

YOUR LANGUAGE
A dictionary where every word has meanings, part of speech, examples, register and origin. Readings and IPA. A phonology page built from what you have written. A grammar of 44 chapters — cases, agreement, word order, negation, questions, derivation — whose rules really conjugate: describe a pattern once and every word in that class follows it. A calendar with your own month and weekday names, a notebook, and CSV import for a list you already have.

A PLACE TO USE IT
A timeline where people post lines in their own languages, in their own letters. Each post carries its letter shapes with it, so anyone can read your script without your font, and every post has a gloss so people can follow and reply even to a language nobody else speaks yet. Replies and threads, following, tags, a daily prompt everyone answers in their language, photos with your letters drawn on them, a 30-second voice clip, and a card that turns one line into a picture to share.

Publish your language's page, and download the alphabet or dictionary of a language you like, to read.

FREE AND PAID
Free: a full a–z and 0–9 script, one language, a dictionary of 100 words, and the whole timeline. Plus and Pro add more letters, your own keyboard layouts, more words and more languages. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled.

promotionalText: Draw your own letters, build the grammar, and post in your language on a timeline where everyone can read your script.
whatsNew:
New
- Word generator: suggests words that fit your language's sounds and syllable shapes. The ones you pick go into the dictionary.
- Etymology tree: follow where a word came from, drawn as a tree.
- Combined writing: like Hangul, several letters can stack into one block. Each letter sits exactly where you drew it.
- Export your letters as SVG, all at once or one at a time.
- Quote reposts: add your own words when you repost.
- See who liked or reposted: press and hold the heart or the repost mark.
- Reposts from people you follow now say "Reposted by …", and a profile shows that person's reposts too.
- In a thread, press and hold a post's text or meaning to select and copy it.
- Handwriting keyboard: write a letter with your finger and the closest of your own letters goes in.
- When building a keyboard, select several keys and fill them in one go. They are numbered ①② in the order you pick them and go in when you confirm.
- The "?" on the building screens now shows how to use them.

Changed
- Keyboards can be built on every plan.
- Choosing a character is one screen now, with more kinds of characters to choose from.
- Font and SVG export are under the share mark on the letters screen.
- Showing the meaning is an on/off switch, and a free translation goes into the meaning field as text.
- The post screen no longer jumps when the keyboard appears.
- A ring appears where you tap.
- Undoing a repost or unfollowing asks first.
- A post opened in a thread shows the full time.
- What you see after a purchase is now correct.

Plus many other fixes and improvements.
